comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
dog.chase: Dawg a run yuh down! Step pon it!
Woooi — di dawg dem nuh easy!
Seet deh, di yard dawg nuh like yuh speed!
dog.chase.kingston: Dat Kingston dawg look both ways before him run — smarter than some drivers!
City dawg dem civilised — check traffic first, THEN run yuh down!
goat.hit: Yuh lick di goat! Farmer ago vex wid yuh!
Lawd have mercy — dat poor goat!
Bredda, mi cyaan believe yuh lick di goat. Di whole parish know now.
Goat down! Di farmer ago find yuh, trust mi.
goat.nearMiss: Yuh nearly lick di goat! Be careful, star!
Close one — di goat run cross like dem own di road!
Dat goat nuh know traffic law but yuh nearly kill him still!
